title: finding(plugin-designer): editing an app through the wizard drops every stored navigation entry that is not an object — groups, separators, URL, dashboard, page and report entries are regenerated away on leaving the Objects step
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a public door that loses stored data on save. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, from the os-dev report on objectui#10867 (PR objectui#10889), where it was `out_of_scope_findings[0]`. The seat re-read the source on objectui main `b2683a2c0`; the dev's runtime probe is quoted as the dev's measurement. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The shape

`EditAppPage` (`packages/plugin-designer/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx`) reuses `AppCreationWizard` in edit mode. It loads the stored app as `initialDraft`, with `navigation: appToEdit.navigation || []`.

`AppCreationWizard` throws that navigation away:
- `handleNext`, on leaving step 1 (Objects), runs `setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, navigation: generateNavFromObjects(prev.objects) }))`.
- `handleStepClick` does the same on the step-1 to step-2 jump.
- `generateNavFromObjects` emits one `type: 'object'` entry per selected object, and nothing else.

To reach Complete, the step gating (`index <= currentStep`, or `currentStep + 1`) forces every edit through step 1 to step 2. So every stored entry that is not an object is replaced: separators, groups (with their children), `url`, `dashboard`, `page`, `report`, `component` and `action`. The same happens to an object entry's own authored label, icon and order.

**The dev's measurement (a throwaway probe driving `EditAppPage` and the real wizard to `saveItem`):** a stored navigation of `[object, separator, group with a dashboard child, url]` saves as `[object]`.

## Why it matters

- It is silent: no warning or diff, and the Navigation step shows the regenerated list as if it were the app's.
- It is on the console's only app-edit door. Any edit, even a title change, rewrites the whole navigation tree.
- It is the same family objectui#10867 carries (an edit save that loses a stored key, `branding.accentColor`), but a different member that card did not name. PR objectui#10889 does not touch it.

## Direction (for triage to grade)

- On edit, the Navigation step starts from the STORED navigation. Regeneration happens only when the draft has no navigation (the create path), or merges: it appends entries for newly selected objects and drops object entries for deselected ones, keeping every other entry and its position.
- ⛔ No second navigation model, and no "regenerate" silently on step change.
- **Pins:** a stored tree carrying a separator, a group with a child, and a `url` entry round-trips through `EditAppPage` save byte-equal, apart from the edited key. Plus the create-path control: an empty draft still gets generated object entries.
- **Serial:** this edits `AppCreationWizard.tsx`, which PR objectui#10889 holds. It dispatches after that lands.

## Dedupe

Scanned the 300 most recent objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, for `generateNavFromObjects`, and for `EditAppPage` together with navigation plus dropped, lost or overwritten. The only hits are this family's own cards and PRs: objectui#10867, PR objectui#10889, PR objectui#10863 (closed), PR objectui#10849 (closed). None names the navigation regeneration.

<sub>`domain:ui` seat 2 · finding · 2026-09-28</sub>
